title: CONSIDER: A. RECEIVE AND FILE the annual status report on implementation of the 48 by ’28 Plan, update on Motion 26.1- Protecting Our Small Businesses, and…
text:
[Metro Board file 2026-0235, Plan]
[EXECUTIVE MANAGEMENT COMMITTEE MADE THE FOLLOWING RECOMMENDATION (4-0):]
CONSIDER:

A.	RECEIVE AND FILE the annual status report on implementation of the 48 by ’28 Plan, update on Motion 26.1- Protecting Our Small Businesses, and an update on the 2023 Disparity Study recommendations; and

B.	APPROVE an increase of the maximum contract threshold for the Small Business Prime (Set-Aside) Program for eligible non-federally funded procurements from $4.99 million to $10 million, and a corresponding adjustment to the lower contract threshold of the Medium-Sized Business Enterprise (MSZ-I) Program from $5 million to $10.01 million.
